guide.summary: Dropbox documents OAuth 2.0 for per-user access. Listing App Folder entries uses files.metadata.read through list_folder and list_folder/continue. Register an app with App Folder access, implement the authorization-code flow with a server-side secret, then test one representative individual account with a user token. Dropbox app review and any pre-rollout approval for other customer accounts are not documented in the supplied sources and must be verified before launch. No API call has been executed.
